answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The ember counter is kept in saffron and pigment shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 50 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
